name: faceless-explainer
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：faceless-explainer。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.
unshelve_reason: 问一 · 不是拿走就能用的商品。SKILL.md 第一行就要求跑 `npx hyperframes skills update faceless-explainer` 去拉核心依赖，产图前还要调 `/media-use` 取 HeyGen 素材目录，description 里直接路由到兄弟 skill （`/product-launch-video`、`/hyperframes`）。它是 hyperframes 这套 npm CLI 的一条路由分支，不是单品。同仓库的合集卡 heygen-com-hyperframes 已在架，一个仓库不该占三个位。
